capabilities: Capture notes into an inbox folder and triage them with keyboard-driven actions
Scan the vault for broken links, orphans, empty notes, duplicates and other issues
Preview and apply batch fixes with automatic backups and restore
Build saved search views from eleven filter types with AND/OR logic and fuzzy search
Show contextual panels for on-this-day, unlinked mentions, stale and similar notes
disambiguation: Not a syncing tool; it is unrelated to the author's jemzsync despite the similar suite branding.
extras: The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Analytics are opt-in and off by default, storing anonymous counts locally only. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. All processing is local with no network calls.
problem: Growing vaults accumulate unprocessed captures, broken links, orphan and empty notes, and notes you cannot find without writing queries, none of which Obsidian surfaces in one place.

relations.evidence: If jemzsync is installed, this plugin can show its status

summary: Three-module maintenance dashboard that captures notes into an inbox, scans vault health with fixable issues, and searches via saved filter views.
